title: SLO-tiered yield negotiator with KV ghost-protection for continuous batching
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and implement a negotiator that performs SLO-aware preemption and fair yielding in the continuous batching runtime. The focus is reducing tail latency regressions for higher-tier SLOs while preserving KV cache residency for hot tenants (ghost-protection), and minimizing cross-tenant GPU memory thrash during preemption windows.
acceptance_criteria: Negotiator enforces per-tenant latency SLO tiers (gold/silver/bronze) with measurable tail-latency reduction for gold tenants under load scenarios in our benchmark harness.

KV ghost-protection heuristics prevent immediate eviction of recently-accessed KV pages during short preemption cycles, verified by KV hit-rate telemetry showing <5% drop for hot tenants under preemption stress tests.
End-to-end GPU memory churn (alloc/free cycles) decreases by at least 20% for multi-tenant stress scenarios compared to baseline preemptor.
Feature gated and rolloutable: can be enabled per-cluster with runtime flag and has telemetry for preemption decisions, fallback counts, and fairness metrics.
Integration tests and benchmark scenarios added to perf-harness and CI; no regressions in steady-state throughput for non-preempted tenant mixes.
Documentation and console dashboard panels added for SLO tiers, preemption events, and KV-preservation signals.
implementation_notes: Introduce a Negotiator component in the slice arbiter that combines SLO deficit counters and a ghost-protection window based on KV access recency.
Ghost-protection: track per-tenant KV touch timestamps (approximate, low-cardinality) and assign soft-eviction penalties during decision scoring.
Preemption scoring: score = alpha * slo_priority + beta * (1 - kv_penalty) + gamma * memory_pressure_factor. Tunable weights and tier mappings.
GPU memory optimization: prefer slice shrink over full eviction for tenants with high KV residency; implement compact/merge path to reduce fragmentation during lease handoffs.
Fallbacks: when memory_pressure_factor exceeds critical threshold, fall back to strict fairness round-robin with immediate KV slab flushing as a last resort.
Expose metrics: negotiator_decision_reason, kv_penalty_score, slo_tier, preemption_duration_ms, kv_eviction_count, gpu_fragmentation_index.
Safety: abort preemption if downstream model state indicates in-flight long-running generation (>512 tokens) or function-call interactions.
progress_updates: 2026-02-21: Kickoff meeting with serving runtime and infra. Agreed scope: negotiator + KV heuristic + telemetry. (Aisha, Marco, Priya)
2026-02-26: Prototype scoring function implemented in driver branch (WIP). Initial alpha/beta/gamma defaults chosen conservatively. (Marco)
2026-03-01: Benchmarks: baseline stress-run shows KV hit-rate drop of ~12% under naive preemption. Need ghost-protection to get <5% target. (Perf)
2026-03-05: Design review with PM and SRE. PM requests explicit per-customer opt-out; SRE requests additional safety limits on preemption frequency. (Design feedback incorporated).

2026-03-09: Integration tests added for short preemption windows; found a race where KV touch updates were stale due to batching — fixed by making KV touch updates idempotent and eventually consistent. (Marco)

2026-03-12: Running end-to-end cluster tests with negotiator enabled behind feature flag; initial results promising: tail latency improved for gold tenants by ~18% while KV hit-rate drop ~4%. Preparing PR.
review_feedback: PM (Jordan Lee): Ensure the console exposes per-tenant preemption budget and an override for enterprise customers.
SRE (Nadia Roberts): Add an alert for high preemption churn and automatic disable if the negotiator causes global SLO regressions.
Security (Omar Aziz): Confirm no sensitive tenant identifiers are emitted in negotiator_decision_reason metric; use hashed IDs or sampling.
Design (Riley Gomez): Visualize the KV-ghost window and preemption events on the per-tenant timeline to aid troubleshooting.
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (2w): Add negotiator skeleton, basic scoring function, and feature flag. Unit tests for scoring behavior.
Phase 2 (2w): KV ghost-protection: lightweight touch-tracking, integrate into scoring, add metrics. Local cluster validation.
Phase 3 (1w): GPU memory optimizations: slice-shrink path, fragment compaction heuristics, telemetry for fragmentation index.
Phase 4 (1w): Canary rollout to staging clusters, collect telemetry, tune weights, add console visualizations.
Phase 5 (1w): Gradual rollout to production with SRE guardrails and automated rollback on SLO regressions.
risks: Incorrect weight tuning could starve lower-tier customers and cause increased churn.
KV touch tracking adds additional metadata writes; need to keep overhead low to avoid cost/latency regressions.
Memory fragmentation fixes may have unexpected interactions with existing allocation pools on specific GPU drivers.
Telemetry volume growth — need aggregation and sampling to avoid observability cost blowup.
test_plan: Unit tests for scoring logic with synthetic SLO and KV recency inputs.
Integration tests in CI that simulate multi-tenant mixes and assert KV hit-rate and tail latency thresholds.
Perf harness runs for both short-burst and sustained high-load scenarios comparing baseline and negotiator-enabled runs.
Chaos test: enable sudden capacity loss and verify graceful fallback behavior and no data-corrupting KV evictions.
perf_targets: Gold tier 99th percentile latency: <= configured SLO (target e.g., 120ms) under mixed load
KV hit-rate degradation for hot tenants: <5% compared to no-preemption baseline
GPU memory churn reduction: >=20% decrease in alloc/free cycles in heavy multi-tenant runs
rollout_plan: Feature-flagged deploy to staging clusters behind negotiator=false by default.
Canary enable on 2 low-risk clusters with additional SRE alerts enabled.
Slow ramp to 25% traffic for 72 hours, evaluate telemetry and rollback on regressions.
Full rollout with console toggles for enterprise tenants and automatic disable thresholds.
